svg.text: how much shake reaches the camera
four motors at ~150 rev/s shake the frame; the sensor sees jello
hang the gimbal on soft rubber: tuned to 25 Hz, it passes ~4 %

text.tspan: # below √2·fn it amplifies, above it isolates: keep fn far under the motors
# at 150 Hz: T ≈ 0.045, so the buzz arrives 22× smaller
